name: existing_csq_info_replaced
description: vepyr annotates three records 21 25585733 C>T whose input INFO already holds CSQ=foo (first, middle, last key) to the same output body as native VEP 116: the old CSQ is replaced and the new one comes last.

name: intergenic_variant_single_record
description: vepyr annotates 21 25832817 C>A, a variant with no transcript within 5 kb, to the same output body as native VEP 116: one intergenic_variant MODIFIER group with no feature.

name: of_vcf_multi_transcript_missense_flags
description: vepyr annotates 21 25982445 C>T (rs141331202), which hits many APP transcripts with missense consequences and two transcripts flagged cds_start_NF/cds_end_NF, to the same output body as native VEP 116.

name: of_vcf_one_line_per_record_test_vcf
description: vepyr annotates all 132 records of VEP's own t/testdata/input/test.vcf to the same output body as native VEP 116, which has exactly one line per input record, in input order.

name: output_factory_colocated_merge
description: vepyr annotates 21 25891796 C>T, where the VEP 116 cache holds two co-located variants (rs63750066, CM930033), to the same output body as native VEP 116 --everything.

name: output_factory_hgvs_transcript_protein
description: vepyr annotates 21 25585733 C>T to the same output body as native VEP 116 run with --everything, in which HGVSc and HGVSp are filled (ledger OutputFactory.ledger.toml n=79 and n=80).

name: output_factory_mirna_loop
description: vepyr annotates 21 25573994 C>T, inside the loop of the miRNA ENST00000385060, to the same output body as native VEP 116 --everything (miRNA field miRNA_loop).

name: output_factory_motif_feature_tfbs
description: vepyr annotates 21 25735354 C>T, which overlaps a CTCF binding motif (MotifFeature), to the same output body as native VEP 116 --everything, including TF_binding_site_variant with MOTIF_NAME/MOTIF_POS/HIGH_INF_POS/MOTIF_SCORE_CHANGE/TRANSCRIPTION_FACTORS.

name: output_factory_regulatory_promoter
description: vepyr annotates 21 25734924 C>T, which lies in a promoter of the VEP 116 regulatory build, to the same output body as native VEP 116 --everything, including the RegulatoryFeature regulatory_region_variant entry with BIOTYPE promoter.

name: output_factory_vcf_anchored_deletion
description: vepyr annotates the anchored deletion 21 25585732 GC>G (VEP's VCF form of the Ensembl-format input 21 25585733 C/-) to the same output body as native VEP 116 --everything.

name: runner_buffer_size_invariance
description: vepyr annotates the eight-record chromosome 21 input to the same output body as native VEP 116 at every buffer_size (1, 2, 3, 5 and 5000), so nothing is lost or reordered between the annotation buffer and the output.

name: runner_consequence_content
description: vepyr annotates the variant 21 25585733 C/T (rs142513484) of t/Runner.t to the same output body as native VEP 116, with VEP's 23 default CSQ fields.

name: runner_ref_eq_alt_test6
description: vepyr annotates the upstream fixture test6.vcf (a REF==ALT record 21 25585733 C>C, then 22 25769065 G>T) to the same output body as native VEP 116 --everything: the REF==ALT record does not stop the run and the next record is annotated in full.

name: svtype_svlen_info_ignored
description: vepyr annotates the indels 21 25587759 AC>A with SVTYPE=DEL and A>AC with SVLEN=1 to the same output body as native VEP 116, where each gets the CSQ of the same indel without the INFO key (t/Parser_VCF.t n=14, n=15).
